entities.summary: Zarar Ahmad Moqbel Osmani is a politician in the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan who was Minister of Foreign Affairs and Minister of Interior. Previously, he was Minister of Counter Narcotics and Governor of Parwan Province. Prior to this, he was Chief of Police of Parwan province and First Secretary to Afghan Embassy in Tehran. He also joined the mujahideen during the Soviet–Afghan War, fighting against the Afghan government led by Mohammad Najibullah.
